name: Intelligence
overview: Scripture reveals that true intelligence is rooted in the fear of the LORD, which is the foundational principle of knowledge and wisdom (Proverbs 1:7). God Himself is the source of wisdom, knowledge, and understanding, graciously granting these gifts to those who seek Him (Proverbs 2:6). The prudent and wise actively pursue knowledge and exercise restraint, recognizing that understanding is not merely intellectual but involves a heart attuned to God's truth (Job 12:3; Proverbs 18:15; Proverbs 10:19). Thus, intelligence in the biblical sense is a God-centered pursuit marked by reverence, humility, and disciplined learning.
